candidates: Before merging, remove any FIXME or TODO comments whose described issue has already been resolved by the PR — leftover resolved-issue annotations are misleading and should be deleted rather than left in the final diff.

When calling `process.exit()` on an error path (e.g., invalid user input, argument validation failure), always use a non-zero exit code such as `process.exit(1)`; using `process.exit(0)` on an error path incorrectly signals success to the calling shell or CI system.

When validating user-supplied arguments against a known list with a fuzzy-match/suggestion helper, treat every unrecognised argument as an error unconditionally — set the error flag and emit a descriptive error message even when the helper returns no suggestion, rather than silently ignoring arguments for which no close match is found.
